title.narrative: UNICEF enhanced knowledge of 1.72 million caregivers on Infant and Young Child Feeding practices. 3.6 million young children’s (51 per cent girls) immune system was reinforced by Vitamin A supplementation, 1.9 million children were treated for worm infestations and the micronutrient status of 460,253 pregnant and breastfeeding women (51 per cent) was enhanced with Multiple Micronutrient Supplementation.
